'" | awk -f ~/echo-home/.vim/mimd/lmsh/args.awk' ⏎ let l:awk_out = trim(system(l:awk_command)) ⏎ let l:parts = split(l:awk_out, ',')

- map `neosq` → `: NeosQuit<CR>`
- note: HELP:; - Recall the chat from anywhere (normal/insert/terminal): Alt-n. In visual mode Alt-n attaches the selected lines.; - Ask without opening the float: :NeosAsk <text>, or :'<,'>NeosAsk <text> to attach a range.; - In the float: Enter sends, Up/Down history, Ctrl-X interrupts the LLM, Ctrl-C cancels, F2 raw LLM log, q hides.; - Float position: Alt-h/j/k/l docks it left/bottom/top/right so the windows behind stay visible, Alt-c center, Alt-f full,; Alt-b peek (translucent; needs termguicolors). :NeosLayout <name> or g:neos_layout picks one.; - Approvals: y yes, n no, a yes + always, e edit. neosa (or --auto) skips approvals.; - Scope: Neos acts only with built-in Ex commands, the Neovim Lua API and the functions/commands in ~/.vimrc.neo;; shell, plugins, :source/:execute and os/io are rejected before anything runs.; - Memory: only requests that ended in SUCCESS are remembered (with the actions that worked); ===r forgets them.; - Position: each task is anchored to the window you asked from, even if you move away mid-task; Neos sees every; tab/window/terminal by winid and can act in one, move you there (focus) or type into a terminal (terminal_send).; - Uvian memory is off unless you ask: neosu (:NeosUvian [keywords]) searches it and loads the top hits into your next question;; Enter on any other #n line adds that entry too.; - Neos answers "how do I ..." from your own keymaps: :NeosDoc rebuilds agent_doc.md from ~/.vimrc.neo + mini modules.
- variable `g:neos_python = 'python'`
- variable `g:neos_args = ['--port', get(g:, 'LMSH_PORT', 8080)]`
- variable `g:neos_layout = 'center'`

## HANDBOOK  (~/echo-home/Documents/terminal-handbook/vim-rc.md)
### Git
- Open Git window: ```:Git```
- Toggle file to/from stage: ```s```
- New commit: ```cc```
- Amend commit: ```ca```
- git-diff: ```=```
- git-log: ```:GV```
- Push: ```tty    gpush```
- Push forced: ```tty    gforce```


### Buffers
- List buffer : ```\bs```
- Go Previous: ```Bp```
- Go Next: ```Bn```

### File explorer
- Open file explorer: ```:FgXp .```
- Move window to new tab: ```Ctrl w T```


### Misc
- Handy shell: ```tty```
- Grep text: ```:Grin ${TEXT}```
- Print flat path: ```:Jpath``` , ```:Ypath```
